incarnation: Helios56 selected internal original V2 robot
sourceLimits: Selected individual V2 portrait is original-project internal identity authority only; not an external franchise source.
Chronological age unknown; retain visible proportions, opaque family-safe nonromantic scenes.
Single visible angle only; hidden reverse geometry, tiny unreadable symbols and inscriptions unresolved. Absolute1:1 fidelity not certified.

Old atlas depicts a silver-haired ponytailed human-like woman in close white/black/blue suit, unarmed; source is stocky red/ivory robot with spherical display head and two distinct defensive implements.
Lore entities/background companions are not mandatory character anatomy. Kit mechanics cannot establish invisible gear.

CG13 uses an external officially published image ONLY for Sonic white gloves/cuffs and red-white-strapped shoes. It cannot qualify AURA-7 identity/body, source-canon equipment, an external franchise incarnation, or a canonical crossover.
